sections.text_helper: Section 25.9.9 "I2C PEC register (I2C_PECR)" in chapter 25 (Inter-integrated circuit interface (I2C)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 740.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x20
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Access: no wait states
On the instances of the I2C peripheral that do not support the SMBus feature, this register is
reserved and its bits are forced by hardware to 0. Refer to Section 25.3.
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 PEC[7:0]: Packet error checking register
This field contains the internal PEC when PECEN=1.
The PEC is cleared by hardware when PE = 0.
